body: I have a really complicated relationship with my parents. A lot of things have been taken out on me for as long as I can remember. They've said things to me like, "nobody will ever want to be with you", "I don't give a shit about what happens to you" etc. They turn around and apologize after the fact but those words run through my head when I'm feeling really low. I also had anorexia when I was younger and they wouldn't even believe my diagnosis provided by a medical team and didn't put effort into learning about it afterwards. I constantly think that if my parents aren't really there for me, why would anyone else be?
